title: Arcade Machine
body:
"💛💛💛💛💛"


Description

The Arcade Machine is from the Gift of Golden Times, it plays a minigame based on Cookie Clicker, where instead of clicking to earn cookies, you earn logs.

You can use these logs to buy two powerups, the lumberjack and the handsaw.

  • From the beginning, the lumberjack costs 15 logs, gives one log per chop, and drops a raw log on screen.
  • From the beginning, the handsaw costs 35 logs, giving two logs per chop which drops a sanded log on screen.
  • A gift can drop at any point, increasing the logs given and the speed. It also enables an ice effect on the screen, dropping ice logs.

Appearance

The Arcade Machine only comes in a light red and maroon color, with only a red button and a black screen
